evidence.source: Owner-directed Production promotion 188 to 189 on 13 August 2026, executed through the checked-in guarded pair from exact main e2edf6603c4a29ab0f7f50af369aaff67c6750b0: rollout run 31752340686, gated on FRESH backup run 31751115908 and rehearsal run 31751938850. The backup is this boundary's own and is not the 185-to-188 one; the rollout verified both gating runs against the Actions API rather than trusting the dispatcher, required the rehearsal's head to equal the head being promoted, and required the backup to PRECEDE the rehearsal. The boundary is EXACTLY ONE additive migration, so check-migration-additive.mjs ran as a GATE, and the dry run was required to be exactly 20260813215920_ai_quarantined_evidence_reads by name, refusing a second file. Independent postflight at 23:08Z NAMES the ledger row rather than counting it, beside a total of 189 and the named latest row. WHAT IT FIXED, measured on the INSTALLED definitions before the apply rather than read off a migration: four prediction reads (admin_ai_dashboard, admin_ai_performance_breakdown, admin_ai_recent_results, admin_ai_upcoming_predictions) selected from ai.predictions, and admin_ai_betting_dashboard, admin_ai_evidence_by_market and admin_ai_betting_gate_status counted ai.bets and ai.bet_results unfiltered — the publication gate joining ai.bets not at all, so its settled-bet count and mean CLV came from every bet ever recorded. The defect was masked only because ai.prediction_results holds zero rows, all 37 quarantined forecasts being still upcoming, the earliest kicking off at 2026-08-14T19:00Z. THE PROOF IS A BEFORE/AFTER ON PRODUCTION'S OWN QUARANTINED DATA, with nothing altered between the two measurements. admin_ai_upcoming_predictions returned 92 rows of which 37 carried an invalidated prediction id, and now returns 55 of which 0 do — verified by id rather than by count. admin_ai_betting_dashboard reported 49 open bets and 92.615 units of exposure, and now reports 14 and 23.639, which are exactly the 14 bets whose forecast is still valid; the 35 quarantine-linked bets contribute nothing. Graded, settled, CLV n and the publication gate's settled-bet count were 0 before and after, because nothing has settled yet — that is the window this contract was applied inside. admin_ai_dashboard now states quarantined_predictions 37 beside its graded count, so a shrinking count is legible rather than mysterious. admin_ai_recommendation_log still returns all 41 rows with quarantined_in_page 0, because no recommendation references an invalidated prediction. NOTHING WAS REWRITTEN TO ACHIEVE ANY OF THAT: ai.predictions holds 92, ai.valid_predictions 55, ai.prediction_invalidations 37, ai.bets 49, ai.valid_bets 14 and ai.recommendations 41, each unchanged across the apply. The quarantined forecasts, their gradings and the bets advised from them remain readable through the base tables. Installed-definition custody was verified from the Production catalogue rather than from migration text, with line comments stripped first so prose can neither satisfy nor break the check: ZERO admin AI reads reach ai.predictions or ai.bets, all four prediction reads name ai.valid_predictions, all three betting reads name ai.valid_bets, and admin_ai_recommendation_log — the one stated exception, which keeps its rows so an append-only decision log does not lose them — names ai.prediction_invalidations. Security is unchanged and measured: all 13 admin_ai_* functions are SECURITY DEFINER with an empty search_path and call require_competition_admin(), 13 are executable by authenticated, 0 by anon, and neither ai.valid_bets nor ai.valid_predictions is granted to any browser role. ZERO PROVIDER CALLS were made by the backup, the rehearsal or the rollout: ai.api_usage holds 10 rows before and after. PAID ODDS COLLECTION WAS DELIBERATELY LEFT ON. ai.api_budget.collection_enabled is true before and after and the workflow asserts it unchanged rather than disabling it, because this contract alters admin evidence reads and no provider custody. cron.job holds 14 jobs before and after with the four ai-odds schedules unchanged at 30 12 * * 2, 30 13 * * 2, 30 16 * * 5 and 30 17 * * 5, and Euro publication remains hidden. This is database promotion only: it publishes no Euro 2028, launches no competition, imports no football and claims no Netlify application publication.
